_about: Read by run-iteration.ps1 before every firing. Routes the queue item named by STATE's `current` to a model and an effort. Per field, the first source that sets it wins: the item's own model/effort, then the first rule whose `match` regex (case-insensitive) matches the item id, then `default`, then STATE's top-level model. Operator decision 2026-09-15: spec rounds and the adversarial review stay on Opus; builds, drives and bookkeeping run on Sonnet. Edit this file to tune; no script change needed.
